answer: An agent marketplace requires every trading identity to lock a $100 bond while active and for 30 days after exit. Whether a job tracks ferrous scrap, counts raven sightings, or prices violet dye, the bond applies separately to each identity. Running 10,000 fake identities therefore ties up $1 million, with a month’s withdrawal delay. This makes each additional sybil consume capital, imposing financing costs even when account creation is free.
